headers.//: Every document path must revalidate. Header rules match the REQUEST path, not the file the SPA rewrite resolves to, so a rule on '**/*.html' never covers '/', '/login' or '/app/...' — those fell through to Firebase's default max-age=3600 and pinned browsers to a stale index.html (and therefore to the previous immutable bundle) for an hour after every deploy.
Listed last so it wins for hashed assets, which are safe to cache forever.
